title: Refuge from the Storm
description:
As Hurricane Matthew encroaches the Moody AFB flight line, Team Tyndall hosts their aircraft as they seek refuge from the storm.

Suggested Lead: For anyone that's experienced the devastating effects of a hurricane, they know that taking action early is the best policy, and the United States Air Force is no different.  Airman First Class Roswell Sartwell brings us to Tyndall Air Force Base, where they host evacuated aircraft. 

Suggested Tagout: Team Tyndall hosted more than thirty aircraft on their flight line, which will remain there until notified that conditions are safe for return.
keywords: A-10, Moody, Tyndall, Sartwell, Hurricane Matthew
